family_reports.body: Family court is a circus and for all of the lip service to “children’s best interest”, my kids are BY FAR, worse off today because of it.

The aftermath of these proceedings affected not only me, but my children, their mental health and well-being, my livelihood, and the overall stability of my family. The court system has allowed a multi-offender DV abuser to weaponize the court system.
